brief:
Israel's Central Elections Committee confirmed the official results of the recent election, rejecting allegations of fraud, Al Jazeera English reported. The announcement came as President Isaac Herzog began consultations on which party leader should attempt to form the next government.

Netanyahu's political allies declined to endorse the confirmed results, according to the report. The rejection signals potential complications as coalition negotiations proceed following the election.
dek: Netanyahu’s allies refuse to back the result, as President Herzog begins talks on who should form the next government.
title: Israel's election commission rejects fraud claims as coalition talks begin
